To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we can automatically assess the credibility of a message by analyzing the way it propagates through Twitter.

we have developed methods that can automatically identify credible and non credible messages in Twitter with a precision of 70% and a recall of 80%, based on features from the text of messages, from the users' posting behavior, and from the messages' propagation.

there are measurable, statistically significant differences in how credible and non credible tweets propagate on Twitter, that these differences can be exploited in automatic methods to assess the credibility of a tweet, and that these methods can be used to identify credible and non credible items with precision and recall between 70% and 80% on a recent sample.

the information credibility of tweets on Twitter is not as high as one would expect, but that it is possible to automatically detect credible tweets, and to use them as a starting point for a manual verification of the credibility of a topic.
we have shown that there is a strong correlation between the credibility of a tweet and the number of users retweeting it.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
there are measurable and quantifiable differences in the propagation of credible and not credible messages on Twitter.
we can use the propagation patterns of tweets and their content to automatically assess the credibility of a tweet.
we are able to automatically identify tweets that are credible and those that are not, using features extracted from the tweets, the users and their behavior.
The main takeaway from our work is that

there is a measurable and significant difference between the propagation of credible and not credible messages on Twitter, and that these differences can be captured by features that are easily computable and can be used for credibility classification.
the credibility of a message can be predicted based on its propagation behavior.
it is possible to develop automatic methods for identifying credible and non credible information propagated on Twitter.
